each-workflow-activates-its-reserves: Each workflow activates its reserves during a time window, once enough members are in a live game session. Runs on your account, no need to be online. Add as many as you need.
get-a-discord-message-in: Get a Discord message in a channel you choose every time a boost fires, so the whole clan knows it is live.
log-in-with-wargaming-to: Log in with Wargaming to set it up
only-an-officer-of-this: Only an officer of this clan can set this up.
set-your-hours-and-reserves: Set your hours and reserves once; the boosts fire on time on their own, even when nobody is around to press the button.
